structural-causal.basis: Regulated utility infrastructure and contracted generation/storage directly serve rising electricity demand.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience

discovery-weak-signals.name: Scaled regulated power platform
discovery-weak-signals.basis: The proposed combination broadens regulated customer and generation scale during accelerating power-demand investment.

adversarial-red-team.name: financingSensitivity
adversarial-red-team.basis: Large capital programs and a major combination increase sensitivity to cost of capital and allowed returns.

adversarial-red-team.name: regulatoryConcentration
adversarial-red-team.basis: Regulated economics depend on multiple commissions and approval/rate outcomes.

adversarial-red-team.name: confidenceInflation
adversarial-red-team.basis: Scale and backlog should not be treated as realized synergies or returns before approval, construction and operation.

expectations-execution.name: Capital deployment execution
expectations-execution.basis: Earnings growth, regulated capital growth and new backlog indicate continued conversion of power-demand investment into operating scale.

thesisQuality.basis: Scaled regulated utility infrastructure and contracted generation/storage serve durable electricity demand with demonstrated long-duration capital deployment; merger execution tempers the exceptional band.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Regulated capital growth, earnings growth and project backlog support strong momentum, offset by capital intensity and financing sensitivity.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Independent market data shows roughly $157.7B market cap, ~17x trailing P/E and ~18.5x forward P/E, a reasonable growth-adjusted valuation rather than rare asymmetry.

catalystScore.basis: Transaction approvals, regulated investment and contracted project conversion are identifiable catalysts, but merger timing and conditions remain uncertain.

governancePower.basis: Long operating/capital deployment history supports strong governance, while the large combination and affordability commitments add execution and allocation uncertainty.

alignment2036.basis: Dependable electricity, grid investment, storage and diverse generation are foundational across multiple electrification, AI/data-center and industrial-growth futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Regulated utility, generation, storage and development capabilities create multiple demand engines, though they share power-market and financing exposure.

bottleneckControl.basis: Regulated grid infrastructure and dependable generation/storage are scarce system-critical assets with long permitting/construction lead times and limited near-term substitutes.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Diversified regulated and contracted power assets can perform across several demand scenarios, while financing/regulatory outcomes remain common sensitivities.

substitutionResilience.basis: Generation technologies can substitute, but grid delivery and dependable electricity service remain necessary; portfolio breadth improves adaptation.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Large diversified development scale supports procurement flexibility, but equipment, interconnection, permitting and construction dependencies remain material.

pricingPower.basis: Regulated allowed returns and contracted assets protect economics better than commodity pricing, but commissions, affordability commitments and financing costs constrain unilateral pricing.

riskEvidence.basis: Regulatory approval/conditions, financing costs, integration complexity and capital intensity can reduce realized returns despite durable power demand.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Recent issuer Q2 and transaction evidence covers operating and strategic facts and independent current market data covers valuation; final merger conditions and realized synergies remain unknown.

scoreRecord.thesis: NextEra owns scaled, difficult-to-replace power infrastructure aligned with accelerating electricity demand; capital cost, regulation and merger execution determine how much structural demand converts to value.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Financing and regulatory costs can outrun allowed or contracted returns, particularly during a large integration cycle.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Dominion transaction regulatory milestones and Q3 2026 earnings/capital deployment updates.
